decisions: Corrected minutes from the November 12, 2025 meeting approved unanimously.
Q4 financial performance report accepted and approved.
Pierre Dubois to present a SaaS contract renegotiation strategy by January 31, 2026.
Discretionary spending freeze of 15% enacted for the remainder of Q4 2025.
Aiyana Park to assign a dedicated project lead exclusively to the Northwind Partners account effective December 16, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to schedule a senior-level client success meeting with Northwind Partners leadership before December 31, 2025.
Pierre Dubois to review the Northwind Partners penalty clause impact and explore goodwill gesture options for contract renewal.
Formal Northwind Partners remediation plan to be submitted to the board by January 10, 2026.
2026 Strategic Growth Plan framework approved in principle, subject to revision.
Aiyana Park to develop a phased hiring plan by February 14, 2026.
Pierre Dubois to commission a third-party ESG advisory market sizing report by February 28, 2026.
Full 2026 Strategic Growth Plan to be presented for formal approval at the February 2026 board meeting.
Technology infrastructure upgrade proposal approved in principle.
Pierre Dubois to complete a break-even and ROI analysis for the technology upgrade by January 15, 2026.
Aiyana Park to issue an RFP to three qualified vendors by December 20, 2025.
Vendor selection and contract execution for technology upgrade to be completed by March 31, 2026.
Year-end bonus pool of $1.1M approved unanimously.
Department heads to submit bonus allocation proposals to Margaret Holvan by December 17, 2025.
Employee bonus notifications to be issued by December 22, 2025.
